description:
List past campaigns (or jobs) this account could RE-ENRICH, each with its label and its total-vs-eligible counts.

This is the other half of internal sourcing, and the one to reach for when the user points at work they already did — "run verify over the Berlin campaign", "we never crawled the leads from last month" — rather than describing a filter. No AST needed.

stages is REQUIRED, and deliberately has no default: every eligible count is scoped to the stages the NEW run would enable, so a defaulted stage set would silently answer a question the user did not ask about a number they are about to size a purchase against.

kind='job' lists individual jobs (one location each) instead of whole campaigns. That is the escape hatch when a campaign's eligible count exceeds the per-job record ceiling: split it by location and run the pieces.

Reads only. Picking a run is free; only the submit is not.

campaign_id.description: With kind='job', list the jobs INSIDE this campaign.

exclude_without_website.description: Exclude leads with no website at all. Defaults to true.

kind.description: 'campaign' (default) or 'job'. Use 'job' to split a campaign that is too big to run in one go, or to reach standalone lead searches.

stages.description: Stages the NEW run would enable: 'spidersite' (crawl the website), 'spiderverify' (verify emails), 'vayapin' (publish a PERMANENT public profile page). Eligibility is scoped to THIS set — a lead missing only VayaPin is still eligible for a VayaPin-only run. At least one stage must leave a trace in the corpus.

workspace.description: Tenant to target (cli_…). Omit to use the active/bound workspace. list_workspaces shows the options.

name: list_bulk_past_runs
